conditions: The assertion refers to the two import forms in the base report.
limitations: It describes ordinary import visibility and the selected names. Both import forms can coexist.

triggers: Source correction, identity conflict, or contrary primary material.

statement: The November 1989 Modula-3 report distinguishes IMPORT I, which makes the interface name available for qualified use, from FROM I IMPORT N, which makes the listed declaration name available directly.
